fee_notes: The standard initial franchise fee for a single new Center is $49,500, uniform for all franchisees. A 25% discount applies for honorably discharged U.S. military veterans for their first Center only (reducing the fee to $37,125). Under an Area Development Agreement, the fee for the first Center is $49,500, the second Center is $29,500, and the third Center is $24,500; fees for additional Centers beyond Required Centers are per the then-current Franchise Agreement. The fee is non-refundable in all cases.
raw_excerpt:
The initial franchise fee for a new Center is $49,500. The initial franchise fee is uniform for all franchisees receiving this offering, except for the military veteran discount described below.

If you are an honorably discharged U.S. military veteran, we will provide a 25% discount on the initial franchise fee for your first Center only. If you sign an ADA, the discount will apply only to the initial franchise fee for the first Required Center.
